+# Persistent HTTP key-value service
+
+A dependency-free Python 3.11+ JSON HTTP service with TTLs, concurrent request handling, and atomic file persistence.
+
+## Run
+
+```sh
+python3 server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --data ./data.json
+```
+
+Use `--port 0` to select a free port. The service prints only `LISTENING <port>` to stdout; request diagnostics go to stderr.
+
+## API
+
+- `PUT /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}` with `{"value": ..., "ttl_seconds": 60}`
+- `GET /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}`
+- `DELETE /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}`
+- `GET /v1/keys`
+- `GET /health`
+
+Request bodies are limited to 1 MiB. Data is persisted after every mutation using atomic replacement.
+
+## Test
+
+```sh
+python3 -m unittest -v
+```

+# Persistent HTTP key-value service
+
+A dependency-free Python 3.11+ JSON HTTP service with TTLs, concurrent request handling, and atomic file persistence.
+
+## Run
+
+```sh
+python3 server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --data ./data.json
+```
+
+Use `--port 0` to select a free port. The service prints only `LISTENING <port>` to stdout; request diagnostics go to stderr.
+
+## API
+
+- `PUT /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}` with `{"value": ..., "ttl_seconds": 60}`
+- `GET /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}`
+- `DELETE /v1/kv/{url-encoded-key}`
+- `GET /v1/keys`
+- `GET /health`
+
+Request bodies are limited to 1 MiB. Data is persisted after every mutation using atomic replacement.
+
+## Test
+
+```sh
+python3 -m unittest -v
+```

import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path


class ServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.data = Path(self.temp.name) / "nested" / "data.json"
        self.start()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.stop()
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def start(self):
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            ["python3", "server.py", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", "0", "--data", str(self.data)],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
        )
        line = self.process.stdout.readline().strip()
        self.assertRegex(line, r"^LISTENING \d+$")
        self.base = "http://127.0.0.1:" + line.split()[1]

    def stop(self):
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            self.process.terminate()
            self.process.wait(timeout=5)

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, raw=None):
        data = raw if raw is not None else (None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode())
        request = urllib.request.Request(self.base + path, data=data, method=method)
        try:
            response = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=3)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            response = error
        content = response.read()
        return response.status, response.headers, (json.loads(content) if content else None)

    def test_crud_listing_validation_and_restart(self):
        status, headers, body = self.request("GET", "/health")
        self.assertEqual((status, body), (200, {"status": "ok"}))
        self.assertEqual(headers.get_content_type(), "application/json")
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/b%20key", {"value": {"x": 1}})[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/a", {"value": None})[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/a", {"value": 2})[0], 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/keys")[2], {"keys": ["a", "b key"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/kv/b%20key")[2], {"key": "b key", "value": {"x": 1}})
        self.stop()
        self.start()
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/kv/a")[2], {"key": "a", "value": 2})
        self.assertEqual(self.request("DELETE", "/v1/kv/a")[0], 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("DELETE", "/v1/kv/a")[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/x", raw=b"bad")[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/x", {"value": 1, "ttl_seconds": 0})[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("POST", "/health", {})[0], 405)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/unknown")[0], 404)

    def test_expiry_and_body_limit(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/short", {"value": 1, "ttl_seconds": 0.05})[0], 201)
        time.sleep(0.08)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/kv/short")[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/keys")[2], {"keys": []})
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/large", raw=b" " * (1024 * 1024 + 1))[0], 413)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path


class ServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.data = Path(self.temp.name) / "nested" / "data.json"
        self.start()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.stop()
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def start(self):
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            ["python3", "server.py", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", "0", "--data", str(self.data)],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
        )
        line = self.process.stdout.readline().strip()
        self.assertRegex(line, r"^LISTENING \d+$")
        self.base = "http://127.0.0.1:" + line.split()[1]

    def stop(self):
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            self.process.terminate()
            self.process.wait(timeout=5)
        if self.process.stdout is not None:
            self.process.stdout.close()
        if self.process.stderr is not None:
            self.process.stderr.close()

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, raw=None):
        data = raw if raw is not None else (None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode())
        request = urllib.request.Request(self.base + path, data=data, method=method)
        try:
            response = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=3)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            response = error
        content = response.read()
        return response.status, response.headers, (json.loads(content) if content else None)

    def test_crud_listing_validation_and_restart(self):
        status, headers, body = self.request("GET", "/health")
        self.assertEqual((status, body), (200, {"status": "ok"}))
        self.assertEqual(headers.get_content_type(), "application/json")
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/b%20key", {"value": {"x": 1}})[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/a", {"value": None})[0], 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/a", {"value": 2})[0], 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/keys")[2], {"keys": ["a", "b key"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/kv/b%20key")[2], {"key": "b key", "value": {"x": 1}})
        self.stop()
        self.start()
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/kv/a")[2], {"key": "a", "value": 2})
        self.assertEqual(self.request("DELETE", "/v1/kv/a")[0], 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("DELETE", "/v1/kv/a")[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/x", raw=b"bad")[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/x", {"value": 1, "ttl_seconds": 0})[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("POST", "/health", {})[0], 405)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/unknown")[0], 404)

    def test_expiry_and_body_limit(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/short", {"value": 1, "ttl_seconds": 0.05})[0], 201)
        time.sleep(0.08)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/kv/short")[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.request("GET", "/v1/keys")[2], {"keys": []})
        self.assertEqual(self.request("PUT", "/v1/kv/large", raw=b" " * (1024 * 1024 + 1))[0], 413)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
